verifiedControls.conclusion: Both frozen input layouts are317state+68action=385 and331state+68action=399. First-layer prefix begins with the same b1[j] and uses ascending i products in the original Number order, stores the completed accumulator in Float64, then continues ascending suffix products. It does not add two independently accumulated sums or round prefix into Float32. Math.tanh then h1 Float32, original second-layer Number order/tanh/h2 Float32, and original final-layer Number order/output Float32 remain unchanged. No cross-call prefix/score/weight cache.
